description: NOT IN lowers to a negated IN on graph dialects; SQL/PGQ and DuckPGQ use <> ALL for a list parameter.

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT (p.name IN $p0) RETURN p.name

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT (p.name IN $p0) RETURN p.name $$, %s) AS (name agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT (p.name IN $p0) RETURN p.name

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) WHERE p.name <> ALL($p0) COLUMNS (p.name))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) WHERE p.name <> ALL($p0) COLUMNS (p.name))
